text: lin-answer-now 是一个面向 DSH Web 的效率插件，通过系统提示和工具结果钩子帮助 agent 及时结束查询并给出答复。它按每轮工具调用次数逐级发送提醒，也可识别同一工具及参数的重复调用；另可在回合结束时用模型评分，低于阈值时要求 agent 修订答案。插件管理页提供配置面板，可调整阈值、工具范围、重复提醒和审查选项，配置保存在本机 DSH 目录。无需单独填写密钥；启用答案审查时会将本轮用户提示和回答交给所选模型评分。

lin-answer-now nudges DSH agents to answer promptly with system guidance and tool-call reminders. It flags repeated queries and can send prompts and answers to a model for scoring, requesting revisions to low scores. Its plugin-manager panel configures thresholds and review settings stored locally.
想让 DSH 在工具调用太多时提醒 agent 尽快整理答案。
希望每轮结束后由模型检查回答，低分时让 agent 修改。
Can DSH remind the agent to stop repeating the same tool query and respond with what it found?
lin-answer-now 的功能「分级收尾提醒」：统计每轮成功工具调用，在达到配置阈值时向 agent 收件箱加入逐级提醒；相同工具和参数反复执行也会触发提醒。工具筛选、排除、冷却和重复次数可在配置中调整。
lin-answer-now 的功能「答案评分与修订」：每轮结束时把用户提示和回答提交给配置的审查模型评分；低于分数线时将审查意见交给 agent 重试，并受最大重试次数限制。可关闭此功能或调整模型和评分参数。
lin-answer-now 使用答案审查时，会将本轮用户提示和 assistant 回答发送给当前或指定的审查模型评分；是否发往外部服务取决于 DSH 模型配置。

lin-answer-now README · answer-now：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that pushes the agent to **deliver its answer as soon as it has one**, instead of burning your time on extra queries.

lin-answer-now README · What it does：1. **Injects instructions into the system prompt** — stop querying the moment you can answer, never repeat a query, prefer one decisive query over several narrow ones, no filler tool calls.
2. **Counts tool calls per agent per turn** — and when the count crosses a threshold, injects an escalating reminder into the agent's inbox ("answer now instead of querying further" → "stop calling tools and produce your final answer").
3. **Resets on new user messages**, so each of your turns starts fresh.
lin-answer-now README · What it does：It is advisory-only: it never blocks or rejects a tool call, so it can't break a legitimate workflow.

lin-answer-now README · Install：From npm (prebuilt, no build step):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add lin-answer-now
```

Or from GitHub source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/lin1213812138/lin-answer-now
```

Then restart `dsh web` (or reload the page) and you're done.

> **Can't reach npm?** Install straight from the GitHub source — this needs no npm account or login:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/lin1213812138/lin-answer-now
> ```

lin-answer-now README · Installing on another machine (中文说明见 README.zh.md)：Each machine has its own DSH profile, so the plugin isn't shared automatically. On the other computer, just run one of the install commands above (use `dsh profile list` to find the profile name if it isn't `desktop`), then restart `dsh web` (or reload the page).
